title: Multi-omics analyses reveal the mechanisms of developmental toxicity of a covalent organic framework to the roots of rice (Oryza sativa) seedlings
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,3653-3668
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00008D, Paper
Xile Deng, Yujun Xu, Yanan Deng, Simin Yu, Le Qian
EB-COFs inhibit rice root growth through oxidative stress and disruption of phenylpropanoid biosynthesis, glutathione metabolism and MAPK signaling pathway, highlighting the need for plant-focused environmental risk assessment of COFs.
